sources.role: administrative census crosswalk and named locality context; not physical coastline data or a settlement point gazetteer
sources.vintage: 2022 Housing and Population Census, Volume III; methodology report issued for the 2022 census
sources.license: No explicit open redistribution license identified. Do not retain the report bytes; use the official restoration URL and cited tables only.
sources.facts: The census distinguishes nine Mauritius Island geographical districts from 12 administrative regions (five Municipal Council Areas and seven District Council Areas), 30 municipal wards, and 130 Village Council Areas; about 30 VCAs cross two or three geographical districts. Rodrigues has six local regions and named localities in Appendix IV. These are not geocoded settlement points. Census reported 330 people on Agaléga and no permanent St Brandon residents/count-only; population is not island evidence.
sources.completeness_limit: Administrative names and population totals do not prove settlement coordinates, coastlines, reef emergence, or current subunit boundaries.
